title: Clap Switch Taali Nahi, Sirf Shor Sunta Hai 👏 #shorts
description:
Taali bajao aur light jale, ye jaadu nahi, ek sound sensor ka kamaal hai! Dekho andar kya hota hai.
🎤 Electret microphone ke andar diaphragm aur backplate
⚡ LM393 comparator threshold se signal ko match karta hai
🔧 Blue pot se sensitivity set karna
🔌 Arduino Uno se wiring aur 2 clap ki counting
Aur aise 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo!
#shorts #arduino #soundsensor #clapswitch #ky038 #electronics #hindi
